anims.title: Proto-precursor (Ani et al. Fig. 36a): the four checks

frames.c: Blocks α, β on the track. A clean state passes all four checks in order.
step south onto D. check A→D passed
step south onto G. check C→G passed
step north onto A. check B→A passed
step north onto C. check B→C passed
All four checks legal: the start state is clean. Broken states fail some check and stay broken.
